boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten named study environments in Sonoma State’s University Library, spanning quiet individual work, group rooms, technology, and creative production.

cards.title: Quiet Study Room
cards.subtitle: Third Floor, University Library
cards.notes: Bring silent work and keep your phone muted; take calls into the hallway or terrace, and close the door to reduce outside noise.
cards.short_summary: A designated no-noise room for focused reading and writing.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Library designates the Quiet Study Room as a no-noise study spot and asks users to silence phones and move conversations outside.
cards.source_title: Quiet Study Room | University Library at Sonoma State University
cards.access_notes: Located on the library’s third floor; follow the room’s no-noise guidance.

cards.title: Third Floor Study Pods
cards.subtitle: Third Floor, University Library
cards.notes: Settle into a study pod for quiet individual work and use its charging capability for a phone or laptop during a longer session.
cards.short_summary: Quiet third-floor seating with charging for personal devices.
cards.evidence_claim: The library identifies comfortable study pods on the third floor where users can charge a phone or laptop.
cards.source_title: Third Floor | University Library at Sonoma State University
cards.access_notes: Third floor is presented by the library as a quieter study area.

cards.title: Third-Floor Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Rooms 3010–3022, University Library
cards.notes: Reserve a room before meeting with your group; select a room size that fits, keep doors closed, and plan to finish before third-floor closing.
cards.short_summary: Reservable group rooms in the library’s quiet third-floor zone.
cards.evidence_claim: Rooms 3010–3022 are third-floor study rooms for SSU students; reservations are available during library open hours and are limited to four hours.
cards.source_title: Book a Study Room | University Library at Sonoma State University
cards.access_notes: SSU students only; reserve ahead. Rooms hold four to twelve people, and the floor closes 15 minutes before the library.

cards.title: Study Room 1105
cards.subtitle: First Floor, University Library
cards.notes: Use the booking system before arriving, then reserve within the stated four-hour daily limit and leave the room reset for the next group.
cards.short_summary: The library’s named first-floor reservable study room.
cards.evidence_claim: The library lists Room 1105 on the first floor among its student study rooms and requires reservations for use.
cards.source_title: Book a Study Room | University Library at Sonoma State University
cards.access_notes: For SSU students only; reserve in advance during library open hours. One reservation per day, up to four hours.

cards.title: University Library First Floor
cards.subtitle: Jean and Charles Schulz Information Center
cards.notes: Choose this floor for shared work near computers, printers, charging, and academic support services; use the first-floor room if your group needs a door.
cards.short_summary: An active library floor with technology and nearby learning support.
cards.evidence_claim: The library describes its first floor as a study area with computers, printers, a charging station, LARC, and a bookable study room.
cards.source_title: First Floor | University Library at Sonoma State University
cards.access_notes: Library hours currently listed: Mon–Thu 7:30 a.m.–7 p.m.; Fri 7:30 a.m.–5 p.m.; Sun noon–7 p.m.; closed Saturday.

cards.title: University Library Second Floor
cards.subtitle: Jean and Charles Schulz Information Center
cards.notes: Use this active learning floor when you want the checkout desk, classrooms, creative spaces, or a quick pivot between studying and project work.
cards.short_summary: An active learning floor linking research services and creative tools.
cards.evidence_claim: The library identifies the second floor as an active studying and learning area with the Information/Checkout Desk, classrooms, and Makerspace.
cards.source_title: Second Floor | University Library at Sonoma State University
cards.access_notes: Library hours currently listed: Mon–Thu 7:30 a.m.–7 p.m.; Fri 7:30 a.m.–5 p.m.; Sun noon–7 p.m.; closed Saturday.

cards.title: Lobo's Lounge
cards.subtitle: Second Floor, University Library
cards.notes: Use the comfortable seating for reading between assignments, and pair a session with the popular-reading collection or the nearby scanner when needed.
cards.short_summary: A lounge-style library area with popular reading and a scanner nearby.
cards.evidence_claim: The library describes Lobo's Lounge as having comfortable seating and locates its popular-reading collection there; a scanner is across from the Information/Checkout Desk.
cards.source_title: Second Floor | University Library at Sonoma State University
cards.access_notes: On the second floor; the library’s printing and scanning page places a scanner in Lobo's Lounge.

cards.title: SSU Library Makerspace
cards.subtitle: University Library, Jean and Charles Schulz Information Center
cards.notes: Bring a project idea for prototyping or digital fabrication, check posted hours, and follow staff instructions or training requirements for equipment.
cards.short_summary: A hands-on project workspace for prototyping and digital fabrication.
cards.evidence_claim: SSU’s library says affiliated students can access the Makerspace and equipment free of charge for digital fabrication, prototyping, and related technology work.
cards.source_title: Makerspace | University Library at Sonoma State University
cards.access_notes: Free for SSU-affiliated students, staff, and faculty during posted hours; some larger projects may require user-supplied materials.

cards.title: Media Lab
cards.subtitle: Second Floor, University Library
cards.notes: Use this lab when an assignment needs digital editing; arrive with files organized and ask at the Information/Checkout Desk if you need library guidance.
cards.short_summary: A named second-floor space for editing digital projects.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Library lists the Media Lab on its second floor as a place to create and edit digital projects.
cards.source_title: Second Floor | University Library at Sonoma State University
cards.access_notes: Located on the library’s second floor; confirm applicable equipment availability before a production session.

cards.title: Media Production Studios
cards.subtitle: Second Floor, University Library
cards.notes: Plan a recording-focused work session here when a class project needs audio or video, and confirm setup details with library staff before arriving.
cards.short_summary: A library production setting for audio and video coursework.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Library lists Media Production Studios on the second floor for recording audio or video with professional-grade equipment.
cards.source_title: Second Floor | University Library at Sonoma State University
cards.access_notes: Located on the library’s second floor; verify equipment and any scheduling requirements with the library before use.
